item.title: TWIC 1671 — Weekly Repertoire Highlights
item.description:
November 2026 · 7,379 games screened, 318 repertoire candidates, six annotated highlights.

Model Games

  • White Spanish · De Boer–Jens. See how 14.a4 and 15.d4 set up White’s use of the c-file with 19.Ra3 and 20.Rc3.
  • White Rossolimo · Fedorchuk–Jovanovic. Follow 12.Qe2, 14.e5 and 16.d4 to see how White gains central space. Compare Black’s …c4 and …a5–b4 counterplay.
  • Black Semi-Slav · Peyrer–Korneev. Study how 12…d4 13.exd4 Re8+ 14.Kf1 Qa5 turns White’s uncastled king into a target.

Repertoire Theory Watch

  • Black Grünfeld · Kantor–Samant. After 18…Nc5 19.Be3 Nd3, where can Black realistically choose whether to accept the perpetual?
  • Black Najdorf · Timoshin–Pranav. After 12…Qc7 13.c4, how should Black challenge White’s planned Rd1 and b4?
  • Black Scotch Four Knights · Van Foreest–Duda. What does 10.Qf3 change about 10…Rb8 and the timing of …c5?

Play through the six annotated Lichess chapters · Download the 318-game repertoire PGN under Artifacts · Original TWIC archive.
